algorithms.topology: official signed apply_topn, prune=True for every n1..1624; original score/tie convention unchanged
algorithms.cap: largest audited nominal n with A(n)<=T, including n0; exact-size evaluations are the both-exact labeled subset, never extra forwards
algorithms.interpolation: at T1/T2, linear accuracy interpolation between largest attainable<=T and smallest attainable>=T; flag gap>max(10,0.10*T); no claim of directly evaluated circuit
algorithms.closure: first appearance in officialP(n), n1..1624; ties by original official rank; unseen edges appended in original order; unique negative ordinal scores; verify all known-group prefixes and50 full-range nesting samples; no tail pruning-free claim; full-grid NOMINAL effects only, no matched-size closure evaluations
algorithms.ensemble: within each source vector, signed descending ordinal ranks tied by canonical edge index; equal average of3 ranks; final ties by canonical index; unique negative ordinal scores; no validation weights

cohort.rule: exclude prior official indices plus exact clean and donor hashes from all small prior campaigns includingGate5D and training; deduplicate both/cross-role hashes greedily by canonical row; proportional nine-template largest-remainder quotas then sorted-template seeded permutation; no private test

metrics.official: pinned MIB evaluate_area_under_curve; CPR/CMD/accuracy-logAUC unchanged; official eap.evaluate_graph for exact masks; official positive-margin accuracy, logit_diff, and separate vocabulary top1
metrics.normalization: fresh-cohort clean/empty means; official refs shared across allrankings; matched faithfulness uses same measured references; no homemade CPR/CMD
metrics.cache: immutable exact per-prompt output cache by mask+model+cohort+protocol; no activation caches, no mutable patched activations

bootstrap.unit: shared prompts within exact template strata, fixedcounts; same resample all methods/seeds/targets; fixed trained seeds equally weighted, never3N independent rows
bootstrap.primary: single T1 endpoint, two-sided95% percentile interval; success lower>0
bootstrap.secondary: T2, controls, exact subsets and interpolation use descriptive unadjusted95% intervals
bootstrap.R: pooled cap-difference / pooled nominal0.5%-difference; shared-draw percentile ratioCI; unstable if denominator95%intervalcontains0 or abs(point)<1/cohortN; report invalid draw count

criteria.primary: T1 cap mean>0, >=2of3 positive seeds, paired prompt95%lower>0, all correctness valid
classification: Ranking-quality effect if primary passes and stableR>=0.5
Mostly connectivity if nominal lower>0, primary fails, and (capCIcontains0 or stableR<0.25)
criteria.interpretation: descriptive; R is advantage-retention ratio, never a causal proportion; capped success not exact-size superiority
criteria.ensemble_diagnostic: baselineensemble cap accuracy>=.90 at T2; compare3components without assuming3-run training is cheap

budget.projection: first complete original full-grid wall seconds /10 * plannedrequests (conservatively includes one-time refs); if >7200seconds STOP before remaining evaluations
budget.OOM: stop and report; do not silently change batch or protocol

stopping: stop matched experiment if original A monotonicity/nesting fails; invalid closure skipped, originals retained; checkpoint/cohort/evaluator failure stops inference; no newtraining/furthergates/leaderboard
